description: This file defines the KpiDao class, which manages database operations related to KPIs within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and filtering KPI records, as well as setting default KPIs and checking edit/delete permissions.

classes.name: KpiDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for KPI entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and validation within the performance module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Persists a KPI entity into the database.

methods.name: getKpiById
methods.description: Retrieves a KPI by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingKpiIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing KPIs from a list of IDs, filtering out deleted ones.

methods.name: getKpiList
methods.description: Returns a list of KPIs filtered by given search parameters.

methods.name: getKpiCount
methods.description: Returns the count of KPIs that match the specified search filters.

methods.name: getKpiQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query with filtering and sorting based on search parameters.

methods.name: deleteKpi
methods.description: Marks KPI entities as deleted after checking for eligible deletion.

methods.name: unsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Unsets the default KPI flag from other KPIs, optionally excluding a specific ID.

methods.name: isKpiEditable
methods.description: Checks if a KPI can be edited based on whether it is referenced in active reviews.

methods.name: isKpiDeletable
methods.description: Checks if a KPI can be deleted based on whether it is referenced in inactive reviews.
